messages:
jess: Hey @eng-security — support needs to replay a prod request to repro a model crash. The payload includes headers + body. Can we approve 48h access to raw payloads? What exact fields must be redacted before sharing?

omar: We don't share raw auth tokens. Must redact Authorization and Cookie headers. Also remove any cleartext PII (user_email, phone_number) in the body. Truncate long prompt fields (>200 chars) or mask them.

kevin: +1. Prefer pseudonymize user_id with an HMAC rather than deleting — keeps traces linkable without exposing raw IDs. Do NOT export any unredacted trace/span data. :lock:

kevin: quick rule: replace auth values with AUTH_REDACTED, replace cookies with COOKIE_REDACTED, hash emails with HMAC_SHA256(user_email, key).

jess: Got it. Can someone paste the minimal scrub config we should attach to the ticket so ops can run it automatically? I'll include it in the SR.

tina: Flow we require: 1) Create support ticket with business justification and list of people who need access. 2) Ops runs a scrub + export job to a secured S3 path with TTL 48h. 3) Audit entry created listing who accessed it. If replay is needed, prefer running the replay inside our isolated VPC (ops runs it) instead of handing out raw files. If a file must be shared, ensure the scrub rules below are applied.

tina: Minimal scrub config (ops-friendly):

```
scrub_rules:
  headers:
    Authorization: "AUTH_REDACTED"
    Cookie: "COOKIE_REDACTED"
  body:
    user_id: "hmac_sha256:key=vault:/support/hmac-key"
    user_email: "hmac_sha256:key=vault:/support/hmac-key"
    phone_number: "REDACTED"
    prompt: "truncate:200, mask_email_like_values:true"
  traces: "remove_sensitive_span_attrs"
output:
  s3_path: "s3://redwood-support-exports/<ticket-id>/"
  ttl_hours: 48
audit: true
```

tina: Ops will validate the job logs before sharing link. Also include the list of approvers in the ticket (security + product owner).

jess: Thanks all — filing the ticket now and will paste this config. tagging @kevin and @tina for approvers.

kevin: Sounds good. If you need a quick script to run locally for staging replays, ping me and I'll drop one in the ticket.
